_comment: Single source of truth for 'this outbound link earns PromptQuorum a commission'. A link is MONETISED when its URL carries one of these query parameters or points at one of these affiliate-network redirect hosts. Read by src/lib/tracking/affiliate.ts (rel=sponsored + commission disclosure) and by scripts/apply-gpu-cloud-refs.mjs (warns when a configured code would not be detected). The site's own source tag (utm_source=promptquorum.com&utm_medium=referral) is NOT a signal and never makes a link monetised. Compare names lower-case.
